title: Vatika City - 3BHK Builder Floor in Sector 49

scenes.title: Bright Scandinavian Family Living Room
scenes.description: A warm, family-sized living room anchored by a deep sage-green sectional sofa, a light-wood coffee table, and a soft patterned rug over matte vitrified tiles. A wall-mounted TV sits on a wooden console beside open shelving, while a glass balcony door on the right floods the space with daylight. The room opens directly onto the dining area and the front entrance, making it the social heart of the home.
scenes.caption: Sage sectional, sunlit open-plan lounge
scenes.narration_script: As you step in, you are standing in the main living room - the heart of this Scandinavian family floor. Notice the generous sage-green sectional wrapped around a light-wood coffee table, with the television and bookshelf along the wall to your right and a sunlit balcony just beyond. To your left the space flows straight into the dining area and the front door, and a bedroom and family bathroom open off this same wall. Let's move through toward the dining room next.

scenes.title: Cozy Scandinavian Dining Room
scenes.description: A compact, light-filled dining space centered on a rounded light-wood table for six beneath a warm pendant light. A matching sideboard with framed family photos and a wall clock line the wall, and the room is open-plan to both the living room and the modular kitchen. The dark wooden front door and a balcony sliding door sit along the far wall, while bedrooms and a bathroom open off the adjoining hallway.
scenes.caption: Light-wood family dining hub
scenes.narration_script: Here in the dining room you are at the natural crossroads of the home. The rounded wooden table seats the whole family under a soft pendant light, with a sideboard and wall clock to one side. Behind me the kitchen opens up for easy serving, the living room sits just to the left, and along the far wall you'll find the main entrance door and a balcony that lets in the afternoon light. Step through the sliding door to reach that balcony, or continue into the kitchen.

scenes.title: Modular Family Kitchen
scenes.description: A practical U-shaped modular kitchen in light-wood laminate with black granite countertops, a large stainless-steel double-door refrigerator, gas hob, oven, and a granite breakfast island with stools. A window over the sink brings in daylight, and doorways lead off to a utility laundry area and an adjoining bedroom. It opens directly onto the dining room through a wide archway.
scenes.caption: Granite island, modular family kitchen
scenes.narration_script: Welcome to the kitchen, the busy work-core of this family home. You have a full U-shaped run of light-wood cabinetry topped with black granite, a tall steel refrigerator, and a granite breakfast island with stools for quick meals. Over the sink a window keeps things bright, and tucked to the side are the utility laundry and a bedroom. The wide archway behind me leads straight back to the dining room.

scenes.title: Calm Master Bedroom Suite
scenes.description: A restful master bedroom with a king bed dressed in soft white-and-sage linens, a grey upholstered headboard against a muted accent wall, and twin bedside lamps. Engineered-wood laminate flooring, a tall wardrobe, a reading armchair, and a compact study desk make it a comfortable retreat. A large curtained window with a juliet railing overlooks the neighbourhood, and an ensuite bathroom opens off the far corner.
scenes.caption: Sage linens, ensuite master retreat
scenes.narration_script: This is the master bedroom, a calm private retreat at the front of the home. The king bed sits against a soft grey headboard between two glowing lamps, with a wardrobe, an armchair, and a tidy desk for working from home. Warm engineered-wood floors and a curtained window over the dresser keep it cozy, and you have your own ensuite bathroom in the corner. The door beside me leads back out to the living room.

scenes.title: Modern Family Bathroom
scenes.description: A clean, well-appointed family bathroom in warm beige tile with a wood-fronted vanity beneath a black granite counter and a framed mirror. It features a wall-mounted toilet, a health faucet, and a curved glass-enclosed shower with a frosted window for natural light. Brushed-nickel fittings and folded towels complete a practical mid-range finish, and its door opens back to the central living and dining area.
scenes.caption: Glass shower, granite-top vanity
scenes.narration_script: Step into the family bathroom, finished in warm beige tile for an easy, everyday feel. To one side is a wood vanity with a black granite top and a large framed mirror; ahead is the wall-hung toilet, and a curved glass enclosure keeps the shower neatly separated with its own little window for light. It is a tidy, functional space - when you are ready, the door leads straight back out to the living and dining area.

scenes.title: Road-Facing Garden Balcony
scenes.description: A breezy road-facing balcony wrapped in a black metal railing, with potted greenery, cane lounge chairs, a small glass table, and string lights overhead. It looks out over the leafy mid-rise Gurugram skyline and catches good afternoon light, with a clothes-drying rack and AC unit tucked to the side. A wide glass sliding door connects it back to the dining room.
scenes.caption: Green, city-view family balcony
scenes.narration_script: Finally, step out onto the balcony for a breath of fresh air. A black railing wraps the edge, with potted plants, a pair of cane chairs, and string lights making it a relaxed spot to unwind over the Gurugram skyline. There is room here to dry laundry and enjoy the breeze. When you are done, the glass sliding door behind me takes you back into the dining room and the rest of the home.
